about: What each clip in this folder says, written by build_testset.py when it renders the clip. An item's clip is current when its entry's text and voice equal the item's answer and voice and the file's SHA-256 equals sha256; any other item is pending 'audio' in items.json. render: interactions or generate_content (Gemini TTS), sarvam (a second vendor's TTS, vendor_tts.py) or local (silence, no model). cacheKey: the first 12 characters of the TTS cache key, as gemini_calls.log or vendor_calls.log lists it.
